entries.description: How to read daily salah times, Fajr, Maghrib (iftar) and Isha sections, monthly timetables with Hijri dates, Qibla direction and mosque jama'ah and Jumu'ah times from Pillars city prayer-time pages, plus the in-page WebMCP tools (get_prayer_times, get_next_prayer, get_monthly_timetable, get_qibla_direction, get_jumuah_and_mosques) and the embeddable widget.
